query:
SELECT rs.id, rs.sponsorId, rs.submittedAt, rs.isArchived, s.companyName, s.userId 
FROM rankingsSubmissions rs 
LEFT JOIN sponsors s ON rs.sponsorId = s.id 
ORDER BY rs.submittedAt DESC;
